summary: Inline updater rolls forward to a newer verified release; deprecated dlux_check is advisory-only so pre-1.5.9 projects can inline-update forward.
highlights: Inline update auto-rolls-forward when a newer inline-safe release appears between check and apply, instead of erroring.
The deprecated dlux_check alias no longer gates on its exit code (dlux_doctor still does), unblocking inline updates from pre-1.5.9 projects.
